_README: Questions whose text layer cannot represent what the page prints, transcribed
by reading a 150-DPI render of the source PDF. Applied by stage.py over the
extract.py output, so the correction survives a re-extract instead of being a
hand-edit that the next pipeline run silently reverts.
Two causes, both structural rather than fixable in the extractor:
* stacked fractions -- numerator and denominator are separate text runs
joined by a rule the text layer never mentions, so there is no reading
order to recover. These arrive as blank or scrambled options.
* figure options -- the option IS an image, so there is no text at all.
Every entry here was read off the render and the marked highlight re-checked
against it at the same time. `figure` carries a prose description of an
image-only option, per the schema in README.md.
